scope: Retrospective 17 exposed governed-remediation-plan cases; post-model invariant validation of real pinned Qwen status selection; not new model inference or independent performance.
gate_sequence: INVALID_PLAN_AUTHORITY: plan.authority must equal EC_REMEDIATION_PLANNER_PROPOSAL; on failure require FAIL_CLOSED.
INCONSISTENT_WORK_STATE: any completed_work_ids ∩ blocked_work implies require FAIL_CLOSED.
ISSUE_DEFINITION_GATE: REFRAME only allowed if at least one public issue.action_class/issue_contract key exists.
PRIOR_ART_GATE: after public prior-art work complete, prior_art_gate must PASS or require FAIL_CLOSED.
NONEXISTENT_EXECUTION: EXECUTE candidate must be in visible plan, not completed, not blocked.
NONEMPTY_OPEN_WORK: NO_OPEN_WORK invalid if pending unblocked work remains.
BLOCKED_CONTRADICTS_ACTIONABLE: BLOCKED invalid if pending unblocked work remains.
explicit_non_goals: Do not solve dynamic dependency/urgency; leave outcomes with valid local format uncovered.
Do not call model/Oracle/EC inside validation guard.
Do not substitute EC output silently in baseline; EC fallback results shown separately.
No hidden reference, category or correct-label lookup in guard.
Do not call catch rate generalizable, independent or original S1-S4 Phase1 full A-E.

metric_definitions.wrong_decisions_detected: count(model exactly wrong vs frozen label AND at least one public guard fires)
metric_definitions.correct_decisions_wrongly_rejected: count(model exactly correct AND at least one public guard fires)
metric_definitions.guarded_hybrid_correct: count(model correct when guard allows, EC native correct when guard blocks); separate model and EC invocations
metric_definitions.native_policy_invocation_count: number of guard-rejected decisions requiring actual EC fallback; never count as LLM model success
metric_definitions.uncertain_cases: wrong model outputs whose public guard does not reject; require further EC semantic priority/dynamic authority

preservation: No alterations to frozen Phase1 V1/V2 fixtures, model raw output, selected status or EC source.
